title: AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Persist an item to a DynamoDB table from a Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys a Lambda function, a DynamoDB table, and the minimum IAM resources required to run the application. A Lambda function uses the AWS SDK to persist an item to a DynamoDB table.
